name: sim_outcomes_per_team
description: SimMatch.outcomes() gives one MATCH_END outcome per team (SimTypes.OUTCOME_*, protocol.json's "outcomes"), empty until the match is decided, and MatchClient's RESULT sends exactly those (_outcomes). High Water: a cleared hollow won, a fallen one lost; a match the server's TIMEOUT aborted decided nothing. A race: its win order's decision, one per team.

steps.assert: lib[0].OUTCOME_WON == lib[1].enum_value('outcomes', 'won') and lib[0].OUTCOME_LOST == lib[1].enum_value('outcomes', 'lost') and lib[0].OUTCOME_DRAW == lib[1].enum_value('outcomes', 'draw')
steps.msg: the simulation's outcomes are the wire's

steps.assert: scene.client(1).over and scene.client(1).outcomes() == [0] and client._outcomes() == [{'outcome': 0}] and scene.client(1).decided_by() == ''
steps.msg: High Water cleared: won, and RESULT says so
aborted by the server's cap: nothing decided
a race: one outcome per team, as the race was decided
